C passed every round-36 check, so I've written round 37. The decision is **CONTINUE**: nothing needs outside approval, and the work is not finished.

**Round 36 result (from C's evidence, plus my own gate re-run):**
- Both open bugs are closed. A Clip Gain value typed without Enter is now saved before a fader press (C-R34-01). The doc 036 correction is also in (C-R34-02).
- My gate re-run on the current tree: tsc 0, vitest 1259/1259, build passes. Biome shows only the 2 known line-ending errors in root's auth files. The tree hashes and the 4 protected files all match.
- C found one older bug, **C-R36-01 (Medium)**. It only happens with two pointers at once (two fingers, or pen plus mouse). One pointer is dragging something; the other presses a fader while Clip Gain has a typed value. The field resets to 0.0 and the typed value is lost.
- FB-04 (Clip Gain) and SRW-13 (the mixer controls) stay at "bug open". Nothing new moved to done.

**Round 37 (`current-task.md`, decision D-29z2): C-R36-01 plus two small related items.**
- **Fix:** one branch in `ArrangementDetailPanel.tsx`. If Clip Gain loses focus while another drag is active, it keeps the typed text and shows the "release first" status. Pressing Enter during a drag still resets the text, as an existing frozen test requires. After the drag, Enter or clicking away saves the value.
- **Known limit:** if the user selects a different clip before saving, the kept text is discarded. That is the existing Clip Gain rule. I confirmed the detail panel rebuilds per clip, so this holds even when neither clip has a gain set.
- **Rejected options:** blocking the fader press during a drag (it would also block Zoom and every second-pointer fader press), and saving automatically when the drag ends (it needs a new API across three files for a rare case).
- **Tests:** two extra checks on existing round-36 tests, and 5 new tests written to fail first. Expected: 3 fail before the fix, all 71 pass after, full suite 1264.
- **Doc 036:** one outdated clause about this bug is corrected, and a round-37 section is added.
- **Files:** A may change only those three files. `StudioWorkspace.tsx` is now frozen, and the new frozen list still has 376 files. Expected end state is 10 changed files, or 3 if root commits first.
- **C checks:**
  - C reruns its own two-pointer reproduction: Enter after the drag saves, clicking away saves, a clip change discards (the known limit), and one run at 1280├ù720.
  - C also checks that the unchanged paths still work.
  - It runs 5 mutation checks and the anonymous-access and purchase-protection checks.
- **Ableton:** the manual (Live 12 ┬º18.1) doesn't cover this case, so both rows are marked unconfirmed. I browsed no new source.

**Other updates:**
- I triaged the 10 low-priority suggestions from the Oct 13 code review into the backlog. That added two items: a missing note in doc 015, and the export dialog's focus restore.
- Root can commit rounds 31ΓÇô34 and 36 (the same 9 files). It should do that before A starts round 37 or after C passes it, never mid-round. The browser smoke test (`npm run test:e2e:smoke`) is still root's to run, because A and C may not start servers.
- R35-T is now worth doing: a real-mouse check of the round-36 fix in real Chrome.

**Next:** round 38 is stage 4b, split in two:
- **4b-1:** clicking a fader no longer jumps to the click point, and double-click resets it.
- **4b-2:** the remaining fader bugs, at most three per round.

After that come 4c and polish, then SRW-14..20, the SRW-21 adapter, the full regression, and T12.
